source: Linux VM packet-level emulation; per-trial estimates; no seed pooling
notes: All attempts, failed runs, statuses and censoring retained.
Percentiles describe successful operations only and are nearest-rank.
Outer qdisc bytes include interactive traffic; ratio to download bytes is not pure protocol overhead.
Namespace TCP retransmissions include loopback sockets and do not measure QUIC retransmission.
Identical loss seeds do not assign identical loss to each protocol's application messages.

px.transport: QUIC preferred with authenticated TLS fallback

xray.inner_application: HTTPS TLS with verified owned CA

config_parameters.secrets: omitted; regenerate private configs with provided scripts

hint_provenance.prototype: sparse delayed datagram copies; same executable in both modes
hint_provenance.counter_interpretation: sent_datagrams means accepted by QUIC; first_delivered_bytes means copy delivered first; neither proves physical loss recovery
hint_provenance.counter_scope: session lifetime including warmup; use qdisc deltas for measurement-window external byte costs
